permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends check-ins and clues to your team's Callout server.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Adds your position to check-ins during a run.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Lets you add a photo to a clue.

permissions.name: album
permissions.desc: Lets you add a photo from your album to a clue.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Opens while you hold to talk or pick Clue by voice, and for three short rounds when a check-in is due or the app asks Still there? Audio is turned into text and not kept by Callout. If your coordinator turns voice notes on, the recording of a spoken clue also goes to your team chat.
